title: Biologically informed deep neural network for prostate cancer discovery
summary: P-NET, a pathway-structured neural network, was trained on molecular data to stratify prostate cancer by treatment-resistance state. Its interpretation highlighted established and novel candidates, including MDM4 and FGFR1, which the authors report validating in vitro.
ai_technology: P-NET, a biologically informed interpretable deep neural network

source_review.scope: Europe PMC metadata and abstract only; Methods not read.

evidence.tested: Abstract reports superior prediction versus other models and in vitro validation of MDM4 and FGFR1.
evidence.unknown: Clinical utility and independent replication not assessed (abstract only).
evidence.ai_role: Interpretable network weights prioritised molecular drivers of advanced disease.
